task_title: [P1] Package canonical boardctl tasks with scoped Auger specs and tests for GitReins judging
task_criteria: AC-16: assembling a task context returns only the task, in-scope blocks and required graph closure plus the explicit out-of-scope ids with reasons, and each returned block carries source id, file, version and status. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_task_context.py::test_scope_and_exclusions_are_explicit. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or skips, or pytest reports fewer than 1 passed.

AC-18: the GitReins task packet preserves the board acceptance criteria verbatim, the in-scope and out-of-scope refs, the exact test obligations, the board id mapping and the source digests, and readback equals the approved input with an idempotent repeated export. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_task_packet.py::test_the_packet_preserves_the_approved_input_verbatim tests/test_task_packet.py::test_the_packet_is_bound_to_the_approved_plan. FAILIF: either test fails, is not collected or skips, or fewer than 2 pass.

AC-19: a missing, stale, ambiguous or out-of-scope ch:trace reference starts NO judge and names the invalid row/spec/test ids, while a valid trace starts the lifecycle exactly once with the same board acceptance criteria. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_task_packet.py::test_an_invalid_trace_starts_no_judge_and_names_the_ids tests/test_task_packet.py::test_a_valid_trace_starts_the_lifecycle_exactly_once. FAILIF: either test fails, is not collected or skips, or fewer than 2 pass, or the invocation counts are not asserted.

AC-20: a worker summary claiming a test passed while the required obligation is red cannot produce PASS, and the verdict cites the failed or missing test obligation. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_task_packet.py::test_a_false_worker_summary_cannot_pass_a_red_obligation. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected or skips, or fewer than 1 passed.
